MP Information Commission Summons Cheetah Project Director Over RTI

The Director of Project Cheetah has been summoned by the Madhya Pradesh Information Commission. The summons is in response to allegations of violating the Right to Information (RTI) Act. The commission is investigating claims of denial of information related to the project. The specific details of the alleged RTI violation and the information sought were not detailed in the coverage.
